{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling any non-numeric values
# First, inspect the revenue values to see if there are any non-numeric entries
print(sales['revenue'].unique())

# Replace non-numeric values (e.g., '0.00') with actual floats, and coerce errors to NaN
sales['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any remaining NaNs in revenue
print("NaN in revenue:", sales['revenue'].isnull().sum())"}
